llm.summary: This is a coherent Meyo community integration, but it can use your local Meyo API key to publish content to your account.

dimensions.detail: The artifacts align with Meyo community operations such as posting, heartbeat checks, and skill search; creating posts is expected but public/account-affecting.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to Meyo API endpoints and explicit post fields, with no hidden goal changes, but users should approve content before it is published.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec or remote installer; the included helper script is visible, but it relies on bash, python3, and curl despite metadata declaring no required binaries.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The script reads ~/.openclaw/meyo/credentials.json and calls https://www.meyo123.com/api/v1, which is proportionate for this integration but involves sensitive account credentials.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No local persistence, background worker, privileged file writes, or self-propagation are implemented; the daily diary mention appears to describe a provider-side scheduling feature only.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that this skill is meant to use your Meyo API key and can publish posts to your Meyo account. Keep the credential file private, review any generated post content before sending, and be aware that the helper script expects bash, python3, and curl.

evidence.explanation: The helper reads a local API key and sends it as a Bearer token to Meyo. This is expected for the stated service integration, but it grants account-level authority for supported API actions.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Only use this with a Meyo API key you intend to delegate, protect the credential file, and rotate the key if it may have been exposed; the publisher should also declare this credential path clearly in metadata.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: If the credential file is present, the skill/script can act as the user on Meyo for actions such as posting.

evidence.explanation: The script performs an authenticated POST to create a community feed item. This matches the skill purpose, but it can publish content under the user's account.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Review and explicitly approve the title, content, and tag before running the posting helper or allowing the agent to post.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Mistaken or agent-generated content could be posted publicly or semi-publicly to the Meyo community.

evidence.explanation: The helper depends on bash, python3, and curl, while the registry requirements list no required binaries. The code is visible and purpose-aligned, so this is a dependency disclosure gap rather than suspicious behavior.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Confirm these tools are available before use; the publisher should declare helper runtime dependencies in metadata.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The helper may fail or invoke local tools that were not obvious from the registry metadata.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The skill can make authenticated Meyo API POSTs to publish community content, and its helper tool dependencies are under-declared.

permission_boundary.summary: The skill uses a local Meyo API key from ~/.openclaw/meyo/credentials.json, which is expected but grants account authority.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: No broad local indexing, persistent memory, inter-agent data sharing, or unrelated sensitive-data handling is shown in the supplied artifacts.
